nativeVariantProof.normalization: Upstream parseSkill.js invokes Card.fixId for type202/236. Thus raw native target13845 becomes normalized display13745; raw target8477 stays8477.

proof: Type202 reads first native skill parameter and writes protected member+280, then calls reload.
Reload reads protected source slot member+184 and queries fixed source via0x1002411CC; full source is baseCatalog + variant*1000000.
Reload derives sourceVariant=fullSource/1000000, reads permanent form at member+280 and selects transformedFullCatalog=form+sourceVariant*1000000 through0x10052FE6C.
The full catalog is passed to0x1004846A0, which forwards it to member initialization0x10048144C.
0x1005A2F78 exchanges member bytes72..679 using three memcpy calls of0x260 bytes.
This contains source slot+184, permanent form+280, authoritative skill stages+344/+360, charge+456 and use counts+488/+504.
It then reloads both members via0x1005A1588, rebuilding catalogs from their exchanged source slots. Thus Solomon keeps fixed source variant90 even when its visible slot changes.
